title: React Architect project settings
description: Tells React Architect how this project is organised. Generated code follows these settings.

architecture.description: How the project's folders are organised.

styling.description: How components are styled. "css-modules": a .module.css file with each component. "plain-css": a .css file with an ordinary class name. "tailwind": Tailwind utility classes, no stylesheet. "none": no stylesheet.

paths.description: Where each kind of generated code goes, relative to this file.

features.description: Folder that holds one folder per feature.

framework.description: Test framework for generated tests. "none" turns test generation off.

generateTests.description: Default answer when asked whether to include a test.

rules.description: How strongly each structure rule is reported as you type: "warning", "error", or "off".

layers.description: A layer may only import the layers in its "mayImport". With the default structure: shared components and hooks must not import from features.

entry.description: Code outside a unit (such as a feature) may only import its entry file (index.ts), never a file inside it.

siblings.description: Units of a layer whose "siblings" is "none" may not use each other.

placement.description: Files in the wrong place: outside every layer (when structure.unlisted is "reported"), or in a unit but outside its unitTemplate.

naming.description: File names that don't match structure.naming.

structure.description: The project's own structure. Without it, React Architect uses the feature-based structure: each folder in paths.features is a feature with an index.ts, and shared components and hooks may not use features.

layers.description: The parts of the project and which may import which.

name.description: A lower-case name, such as "features" or "shared".

paths.description: Folders in this layer, relative to this file. End a path in "/*" to make each folder inside it a unit, such as each feature in "src/features/*".

mayImport.description: Names of the other layers this layer may import.

entry.description: Each unit's front door, such as "index.ts". Code outside a unit may only import this file.

siblings.description: How units of this layer may use each other: "entry" only through their entry file, "none" not at all, "any" freely.

unitTemplate.description: What every unit of this layer contains: folders end in "/", such as ["components/", "hooks/", "index.ts"]. Generate Feature creates units like this, and files elsewhere in a unit are reported.

ignore.description: Files the rules don't apply to, as glob patterns, such as "**/*.test.*".

unlisted.description: Whether source files outside every layer are reported as placement problems.

files.description: Glob for the files this applies to, such as "**/hooks/*.ts".

pattern.description: Glob the name before its first dot must match, such as "use[A-Z]*".
